ons.text: Nivea abandons the remnants of her order and travels to Aphetto, where she meets Ixidor, and the two bet on themselves in Cabal pit fights.
Nivea dies at the hands of Phage in a Cabal pit fight, leaving Ixidor bankrupted and swearing revenge in the desert.
In his grief Ixidor creates the angel Akroma in her image to avenge Nivea against Phage.
A deathwurm born from Nivea's murder finally devours Ixidor.
